method: Direct Japanese-source authoring for both locales; complete own-pair AI self-review against every canonical unit. No external translation service, peer review or other-pair reading.
coverage: All lesson and cluster titles, complete explanatory/example paragraphs, application prompts, key terms and both illustration alt texts.
semanticChecks: Pipe connection versus cable connection and communication availability remain separate.
Expansion joints, cable slack, bend radius and tension retain independent confirmation and product/state limits.
Drawings/registers versus actual locations, test excavation scope and multiple asset managers remain separate.
No detector response does not prove no buried utility; marking colors do not determine use status, depth or manager.
Manual excavation does not guarantee no damage; point depths and prior survey limits are not generalized.
Oxygen and hydrogen sulfide results remain distinct; ventilation hardware, visual brightness and training alone do not authorize entry.
No ordinary-mask substitution, unsafe rescue instruction, independent repair operation or added measurement interval.
Japanese special-education and work-supervisor roles, monitoring roles, rescue secondary-disaster risk and traffic/opening/air risks remain distinct.
